title: Cargo Floor Panel — Puncture and Edge Damage Insert Repair

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Insert repair for punctures and edge damage in the cargo floor panels, the most frequent structural repair on the type and normally closed overnight at the line station.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the load carrying capability and the sealing of a cargo floor panel after a puncture or edge damage caused by loading equipment.
sections.damage_assessment: Measure the puncture across its longest dimension and check the panel core around it for crushing by tapping. This repair is valid for a puncture up to 60 mm across that is more than 80 mm from a panel edge and more than 50 mm from a seat track or a tie-down fitting, and for edge damage up to 40 mm deep into the panel from the edge. A puncture with crushed core extending more than 25 mm beyond the visible hole, damage at a tie-down fitting and any damage that has gone through to the lower face sheet are outside the scope. Check the cleat D5350130451983 under the panel joint before the repair is accepted, because loading equipment damage often bends it as well.
sections.repair_procedure: Remove the damaged panel from the compartment and put it on a bench; do not repair the panel in position. Cut the damaged area back to a circular or oval hole with a smooth boundary and remove the crushed core to the depth given on the repair drawing. Dry the panel to the schedule in the standard practice. Fill the core cavity with the approved potting compound and let it cure. Bond the insert plug to the layout on the drawing and apply pressure with the vacuum bag until cure is complete. Sand the repair flush with the panel face and re-seal the panel surface with the approved coating. Where the edge strap D5350139186714 has been damaged, replace it rather than repairing it. Refit the panel with new anchor nuts AES626292-95 at any position where the original has been disturbed, and check that the panel sits flush with its neighbours across the whole joint.
sections.inspection_requirements: No repeat inspection is required for a repair inside the drawing limits. Do a general visual inspection of the repair at every compartment lining removal. A panel that carries more than three repairs, or two repairs closer than 200 mm to each other, must be replaced rather than repaired again. Record the repair position so that repeated damage at the same station can be raised with the ground handling agent.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Puncture up to 60 mm across, more than 80 mm from a panel edge and 50 mm from a seat track or tie-down fitting; edge damage up to 40 mm deep. Lower face sheet must be intact.

repair_drawings.title: Insert repair, cargo floor panel puncture and edge damage

type_data.fastener_pattern: Not applicable, bonded insert. Anchor nuts are renewed only where disturbed.
type_data.fatigue_life_note: No life limit inside the drawing limits. A panel with more than three repairs, or two repairs closer than 200 mm, must be replaced.
